protocol: PATCH-TRAIN-2 RETAIN-1 registration (DISCOVERY ONLY; emulation-consistent; thresholds not used; calibration and confirmation not started)
note_on_independence: the three pairs are the three edges of a triangle on {Brimokvolia, Frosalvolia, Thapylvolia}: they share entities, so they are NOT three independent observations and no rate may be inferred
orders: both A then B and B then A for every pair (six pair-order cases, which are NOT independent: shared entities)

fixed_unchanged.backend: PyTorch CPU f32 eager bs1; frozen v2 emulation f64-seq-rne1/v1

objectives.per_task_loss L_x: conditional-12 + 0.1 * full-vocabulary CE on task x's ORIGINAL training prompt (the objective used throughout)
objectives.N new-task only (control): L = L_second; must reproduce STRESS-CAP-1 arm 5/6 bit for bit (tensor sha256 compared)
objectives.R rehearsal: L = L_second + 1.0 * L_first, L_first on the FIRST patch's original training prompt only
objectives.D distillation: L = L_second + 1.0 * mean over RET of KL( P_W1(.|p) || P_student(.|p) ), full-vocabulary, last-token distribution; teacher = the first-patch-only model W1; RET = the first patch's training prompt plus the training-template prompt of every other discovery entity except the two patched ones (23 prompts)
objectives.weights: LAMBDA_R = 1.0 and LAMBDA_D = 1.0, one declared value each, NOT tuned and not swept; any other weight would be a new registration
objectives.initialisation: negative gradient of the arm's own total objective at the source model W1, at half the cap (identical to STRESS-CAP-1 for N)
baselines_reported_alongside: independent composition (second patch learned on W0, rebound to W1)

reported_per_case: both targets' full-vocabulary top-1 and rank
per-paraphrase rank, top-1 and log p
per-task objective before (at W0 and at the first-patch model) and after
retention against the first patch's isolated model, per prompt
whether the new association was learned
real-fact top-1 and log p, neutral NLL
BF16 numerics and source binding (refusal when the first patch is removed)

classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.first_retained: the first patch's training prompt is full-vocabulary top-1 at the final step
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.second_learned: the second patch's training prompt is full-vocabulary top-1 at the final step
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.coexist: both of the above (the critical test: retention without preventing new learning)
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.paraphrase_retention: of the first patch's prompts (training prompt and 3 paraphrases) that are top-1 in the first-patch-only model, how many are still top-1; log-p change reported, no threshold
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.over_retention: first retained but second not learned
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.advantage_over_new_task_only: the method coexists where N does not (per pair-order case)
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.advantage_over_composition: the method coexists where independent composition does not
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.counts: exact counts out of six pair-order cases per method, and per-pair detail; the cases share entities, so NO rate or general claim is made
classification_rules_fixed_before_runnin.determinism_checks: N reproduces the STRESS-CAP-1 stage tensors (arm 5/6) and composition reproduces arms 3/4 by sha256; a mismatch is a defect, reported, not a result

declared_failure_outcomes: R and D are no better than N: a retention loss at the declared weight does not preserve the first patch at this rank, footprint and cap
retention improves but the second association is not learned (over-retention): preserving the first is not cumulative learning
both patches cannot be top-1 together under any of the objectives: a capacity or interference limit of this single-rank, shared-footprint design
R succeeds but D does not (or the reverse): reported; distillation is the exploratory arm and may preserve behaviours of the teacher that are wrong or miss ones the retention set does not cover
any arm violating the discovery collateral limits (real-fact top-1 < 0.96, neutral NLL > base + 0.15): reported as a failure of that arm
if_successful: reported as a discovery success for the cases concerned only; a separate confirmatory protocol is proposed afterwards; no general continual-learning claim
code_smoke_test: retain1.py was run once for 3 steps on one order of pair 1 to check that it executes; its outputs were discarded and are not results
